stage: M55 training-only prospective screen design; exact prompts must be frozen before forwards
selection: Training-only native competence; retain all attempts and failures. No per-example outcome filtering or gate relaxation.
pre_forward_requirements: Check demonstration/query source overlap and duplicates
stop: One screen of both formats for all seven families. No outcome-based prompt repair. No qualifying additions means report negative and stop. Qualifying additions lead to separately frozen causal target/data-budget-matched experiment, not immediate unreviewed training.
claim: Human-authored task coverage, not new-task discovery; not pristine held-out evaluation.
